ValidationRule.description: Ensure that NCSP cannot select anything other than SKP NA and SB NA
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR($Profile.Name = 'AS NCSP Coordinator',$Profile.Name = 'AS NCSP CSA',$Profile.Name = 'AS NCSP Management'),NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_System__c, "SKP NA")),NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_System__c, "SB NA")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you are NCSP you are limited to only selecting SB NA or SKP NA from Source System picklist field. Please correct field before saving.
